Traumatic Brain Injury: Clinical Characteristics and Outcomes (Badenes (ed.), 2022): IMPACT-lineage prognostic covariate set; GOSE distributions by stratum

Trauma and Emergency Surgery (Sözen, Kanat (eds.), 2022): Triage/operative priority rules; non-specialist-center management thresholds

Hints and Principles for Computer System Design (Butler W. Lampson, 2021): Named design rule-set (approximate, batch, cache, do-one-thing-well) applied as architecture review criteria

Foundations of Data Science (Avrim Blum, John Hopcroft, Ravindran Kannan, 2020): Guaranteed dimensionality-reduction/clustering pipelines for cheap retrieval over a growing shared memory
